decisions.decision: Preserve every accepted provider-observed timestamp. Do not delete, normalize, fill, interpolate or replace historical membership.
Retain the 2010-2012 weekend H1 observations as provider-observed evidence. Their presence does not by itself prove market tradability or authorize a strategy entry.
For later Gate 1B integration, use accepted observations in chronological indicator history unless an existing frozen Phase 1 rule explicitly excludes them.
Entry and setup eligibility must still enforce the frozen strategy-session, market-open, point-in-time and exact-timestamp rules.
Accept instrument-specific timestamp inventories. Never coerce the six instruments onto a shared calendar.
Preserve Sunday 17:00 America/New_York D candles; they represent the normal FX-week opening boundary.
Preserve the exact W inventories of 471 observations per instrument.
Keep failed canary attempt 1 in operational provenance and the operational-evidence-set hash, but exclude it from semantic inventory membership.
Any later provider response differing from the sealed inventory must fail as provider drift. It must never mutate the approved inventory automatically.
